column1: # Cases the audit will not call. Not applied by any script — move a line into
# proposals.tsv yourself if you decide it, or leave it here. See #174.
# Read the name; the code beside it is what the script applies to, and a row whose
# name and code disagree is refused. To see a flag: https://flagfilter.com/?q=<name>
# Columns: name, code, tag, add|remove, confidence, why.

column6: A bishop's mitre is headwear, but "hat" may be meant more narrowly than that.
The upper field reads as saffron; it is tagged orange, and both are defensible.
The latte stone is a carved monument rather than a building.
A tilted helmet sits above the shield as the crest.
The sun is a small faced disc high on the oval shield; round, but barely a design element of its own.
The sun behind the canoe is orange and the brightest thing on the flag; whether it stands out enough under the colour rule.
